prerequisites: Pinned standalone release for the host architecture; no API key. Use repository-owned base/revised specifications and a project-owned security.levels.
lock_resolution: Build the exact inspected source package with private digest-locked Go1.27.3, -mod=readonly, CGO_ENABLED=0 and no automatic toolchain update; preserve go.mod/go.sum and executable/module metadata hashes. No API, account, advisory DB or container is provisioned by a source build.
check: nstack check X-OASDIFF cli (local command health only); complete the per-ID acceptance checks before relying on task output.
deactivate: Each bounded command exits. Shut down only a task-owned stdio process/server if explicitly started; reconcile any effects first. nstack remove-runtime X-OASDIFF cli retains the entire owned runtime under private recovery.
